title: Anna May-Rychter watercolors
content: Anna May-Rychter(1864–1955) was born in Bavaria and learned to paint. She fell in love with Polish artistTadeusz Rychter, who left his first wife for Anna. But being a Catholic he couldn't obtain a divorce. Because they faced social disapproval in Europe for not being properly married, they departed to live in Jerusalem, which provided the subjects for her watercolors.Life sometimes takes us to unexpected places. Wherever those places might be, find your inspiration there.
